verdict.rationale: Gmail is a SaaS product with public developer docs, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis. The probe of developers.google.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no evidence shows any agent-oriented documentation. The REST API guides are ordinary developer docs and do not count as agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
